ValidationRule.description: Can't submit Broker for approval until required fields filled out.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISCHANGED(Submit_Broker_for_Approval__c), Submit_Broker_for_Approval__c=True, OR( ISBLANK(Legal_Name__c), ISBLANK(Website), ISBLANK(Phone), ISBLANK(ShippingStreet), ISBLANK(ShippingCity), ISBLANK(ShippingState), ISBLANK(ShippingPostalCode), ISBLANK(Current_Lenders__c), ISBLANK(Current_Rep_Count__c), ISBLANK(NumberOfEmployees), ISBLANK(Units_per_Month__c), ISBLANK(Deal_Volume_Per_Month__c), ISBLANK(How_Broker_Entered_Space__c) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The following fields must be completed before submitting Broker for approval: Legal Name, Website, Phone, Shipping Address, Current Lenders, Current Rep Count, Number of Employees, Units per Month, Deal Volume Per Month, and How Broker Entered Space.
